cues: To find the orders, run the reaction several times, changing one concentration at a time, and measure the initial rate.
If doubling A doubles the rate, the order in A is one.
If it quadruples the rate, two.
text: To find the orders, run the reaction several times, changing one concentration at a time, and measure the initial rate. If doubling A doubles the rate, the order in A is one. If it quadruples the rate, two. If nothing changes, zero.
